author: harness:codex

patch.value: Own the TOON 4.0.0 major upgrade separately from routine dependency refreshes. Upstream declares no Node engine floor, but the major storage codec must prove byte-level item/history compatibility, strict decode/encode behavior, migration safety, and all release gates before adoption.

TOON 4 is evaluated against canonical item files and history replay; encode/decode and migration fixtures remain lossless; Node 22/24/26 and Bun installed consumers pass; the upgrade is adopted or explicitly rejected with upstream evidence.

value.author: harness:codex
value.text: Duplicate-check evidence: all-status searches for @toon-format/toon, TOON v4 migration, and TOON 4 found storage decisions and prior minor refreshes but no active owner for the 4.0.0 major compatibility decision. npm metadata on 2026-07-26 reports 4.0.0 with no engines field; deferral is for codec/storage compatibility proof, not a claimed engine incompatibility.

message: Create canonical TOON 4 major migration owner

author: harness:claude-code
